description: Combine selected code/proxy observations, contract-reported token facts and one wallet's ETH/Transfer evidence at one provider-finalized Base block. State and logs are selected by block hash, with evidence pointers and a canonical header recheck. At most 18 reads. Wallet history and contract safety are outside the evidence scope. Optional conditions return evidence-linked pass/fail/unknown for exact scalar assertions. Missing or unsupported evidence yields unknown. Reuse an owned contract_snapshot_id only as previous_contract_snapshot in the same scope. This tool accepts no observation_id. One fixed workflow charge of 0.025 USDC via enabled x402 v2 or MPP, or 10 eligible credits using tariff 5 and max_credits. An unpaid call quotes only. Choose inputs before authorization. Save the exact input, proof and recovery token privately. Exact replay returns the retained result with no fresh work or extra charge. No free trial or automatic paid fallback. The same fixed x402 service price may also be paid in native Circle USDC on Solana Mainnet (solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp), when advertised by the unpaid challenge. Explicitly select one accepted network and pin its mint, merchant, amount and sponsored fee payer before signing. Solana payers need no Base wallet; Standalone native Solana MPP solana/charge is also advertised; its client pays a separately authorized SOL network fee, with no server fee sponsorship. Prepaid MPP funding remains Base-only. Payment network does not change the observed chain: blockchain products still inspect finalized Base. Solana delivery requires finalized matching USDC evidence. Persist the original network, resource, input, proof and private recovery capability; never switch networks or authorize a replacement after uncertainty.

chain_id.description: Base mainnet only; provider chain is verified. All state is pinned to one selected finalized block.

conditions.description: Optional 1–8 required checks over evidence already collected. Missing or unsupported facts produce unknown. Outcomes concern only the declared conditions. Omit to preserve the ordinary result.

expected.description: Required for a literal comparison. Text and decimal use strings, boolean uses true or false. Omit for changed/unchanged or when using with_fact.

fact.description: Exact observation field. Website uses website: followed by an RFC 6901 JSON Pointer. Base uses a named base: fact. Cross-domain may also select api:version or api: followed by an uppercase method, a space and the declared path.

id.description: Unique label within this request, beginning with a letter and at most 32 ASCII characters.

operator.description: Greater/less require decimal. Changed/unchanged require a website field and a compatible prior JSON observation, and take no comparison operand.

type.description: Exact scalar type. Decimal expected values are quoted fixed-point strings, with at most 78 integer and 18 fraction digits.

with_fact.description: Cross-domain only. Compare with this second field of the same type instead of a literal.

contract_address.description: One selected contract which is also the token-facts and Transfer-log contract. The workflow does not infer that arbitrary bytecode is a safe or compliant token.

detail.description: Default compact: at most 20 evidence items per section. Expanded allows at most 200 document findings or 100 Base events and retains raw validated logs/getter ABI details within the same fixed work/output ceiling. Counts and omitted-evidence warnings remain explicit.

previous_contract_snapshot.description: Optional owned contract_snapshot_id from this workflow's same narrow code/proxy scope; incompatible primitive snapshots are rejected. Allows bounded selected-contract comparison.

wallet_address.description: One selected wallet. Returns its exact native-ETH balance and this contract's provider-reported Transfer events at the single selected finalized block, not complete wallet history.
